lines.text: حضیف مقدار یازده جزو و ثلثان جزویست تقریبا باجزایی که نصف قطر فلک مایل او شصت
lines.en: The perigee is an amount of eleven degrees and two-thirds of a degree approximately, in degrees of which the radius of its inclined sphere is sixty.

lines.text: باشد و برهان هندسی بر انها اقامت کرده اند لیکن ایراد آن اینجا مناسب نیست و نطاق اوّل
lines.en: And they have established a geometrical proof for them, but its presentation here is not appropriate. And its first sector

lines.text: اوجی آن بود که چون افتاب باند و یرسابر کواکب از اوج گذرد در و باشد و باقی بر توالی
lines.en: of the apogee is that when the sun with the epicycle of the other planets passes from the apogee, it is in it, and the rest are in succession.

lines.text: حرکت خارج مرکز نطاق اوّل تدويري انکه چون مرکز کوکب از ذروه مرئي گذرد دور
lines.en: The motion of the eccentric of the first epicyclic sector is that when the center of the planet passes from the visible apogee, it is in it.

lines.text: باشد و باقي بر توالي حرکت تدوير و کوکب در نطاق اوّل و دوّیم هابط بود و در نطاق
lines.en: And the rest are in succession of the motion of the epicycle. And the planet in the first and second sector is descending, and in the sector

lines.text: سیّم و چهارم صاعد و در نطاق چهارم و اوّل مستعلی بود و در نطاق دوّیم و سیّم متخفّف
lines.en: third and fourth is ascending, and in the fourth and first sector it is rising, and in the second and third sector it is descending.

lines.text: و اهل احکام اینها را از جمله قوّه و ضعف کواکب شمرند چنانکه در باب نوزدهم معلوم گردد
lines.en: And the astrologers count these among the strengths and weaknesses of the planets, as will be known in the nineteenth chapter.

summary.headline: Apogee and Epicyclic Sectors
summary.text: Discussion of apogee, perigee, eccentric and epicyclic sectors, including planetary ascent and descent as strengths or weaknesses. Ephemerides record the apogee sector of each planet’s epicycle center and the planet’s own sector at the beginning of each Jalali month.
